value: At Wyrmrest Temple, Krasus lends the seekers a record of the ancient blade. Kalecgos asks whether mortals should command such power: the dragons have known the grief of a mighty weapon turned against them. Alexstrasza permits the search to continue, though permission is not an answer to every fear. Beneath the red-bronze shrine, the hilt’s past begins to emerge as both a promise and a warning.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
